meta.name: lipsync
meta.description: Lip-sync a face to a specific audio track on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across ByteDance OmniHuman (audio-driven full-body avatar from a portrait + audio), Sync Labs sync v2 / Pro (state-of-the-art mouth sync onto a video), Kling lipsync (audio-to- video and text-to-video with synced speech), and Creatify lipsync. The skill picks the right endpoint for the user's actual intent — portrait still + audio (avatar-style), source video + audio (mouth- swap on existing footage), or generate-and-sync from a script. Triggers on "lip sync", "lipsync", "make this video speak", "match audio to mouth", "dub video", "sync lips to voice", "Sync Labs", "voiceover sync", or any explicit ask to drive a face's mouth from an audio track.

copy.tagline: 将音频与面部视频自动对口型同步
copy.tagline_en: Sync a face's mouth movements to any audio track automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to match a person's lip movements in a video to a given audio track.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的视频和音频，让视频中人物的嘴型与音频同步。它支持多种方式：用一张照片加音频生成说话的头像，或者替换现有视频中的嘴型，甚至根据文字脚本直接生成带语音的视频。
howto.when: 当你提到“唇同步”、“lipsync”、“让这段视频说话”、“匹配音频到嘴型”、“配音视频”、“同步嘴唇到声音”、“Sync Labs”、“配音同步”等关键词，或明确要求让视频中人物的嘴型跟随音频时触发。

say.text: 让这张照片说出这段音频的内容。
把这个视频的嘴型换成这段音频。
根据这个脚本生成一段带语音的视频。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Kling 等模型生成视频并同步语音。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can sync a face's mouth movements to a specific audio track. It supports: turning a portrait photo + audio into a talking-head video, swapping the mouth on an existing video with new audio, or generating a video with synced speech from a script.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "lip sync", "lipsync", "make this video speak", "match audio to mouth", "dub video", "sync lips to voice", "Sync Labs", "voiceover sync", or explicitly ask to drive a face's mouth from an audio track.

say_en.text: Make this photo speak the audio.
say_en.note: Claude will use OmniHuman to generate a talking-head video.

say_en.text: Swap the mouth on this video with this audio.
say_en.note: Claude will use Sync Labs or similar for mouth-swap.

say_en.text: Generate a video with synced speech from this script.
say_en.note: Claude will use Kling or similar to generate video and sync speech.
